admin.globalChatSearchLimit: Global chat search result fix limit at 200
admin.perRoomSearchLimit: The limit above only applies to posts/topics. Per-chatroom search result fix limit at 100
admin.searchMinTermLengthHelp: Queries in which every word is shorter than this (in characters) are skipped. Minimum 2. Dodges a NodeBB core highlight bug that surfaces on 1-character searches.
admin.rankingRulesHelp: In order to ensure relevant results, search responses are sorted based on a set of consecutive rules called ranking rules. For more information read the docs here:
admin.rankingRulesFormHelp: Use the following syntax for custom rules: 'attribute:asc' or 'attribute:desc'. For more information read the documentation here:
admin.stopWordsHelp: Stop words are stripped from a search query only when the query also contains at least one non-stop word. If the entire query consists of stop words, Meilisearch will still search using that term (it is not ignored). For more information on Meilisearch's stop word behavior, see:
admin.stopWordsFormHelp: For more information read the documentation here:
admin.synonymsHelp: Words that Meilisearch should consider as having equivalent meaning in order to make search results more relevant. For more information read the docs here:
admin.synonymsFormHelp: Add synonyms as a comma separated list (eg. 'word,utterance,phrase')
admin.typoToleranceMinWordSizeOneTypo: Minimum word size for one typo
admin.typoToleranceMinWordSizeTwoTypos: Minimum word size for two typos
admin.typoToleranceDisableOnWords: Disable typo tolerance on specified words
admin.typoToleranceDisableOnWordsHelp: Typo tolerance is disabled only when one of these words is typed exactly in the search query; that query word will not match typo variants in the index. Note: searching a misspelling of a disabled word will still match the correctly-spelled document via tolerance. For more information see:
admin.reindexHelp: Index all posts and topics again, in case of a mismatch between Meilisearch and NodeBB. This can take a while depending on the number of posts and topics in your forum.
admin.confirmReindex:
Are you sure you want to start reindexing all posts and topics?
This operation can take a while.
admin.confirmSemanticSave:
This changes the semantic search provider, credentials, model, URL, or dimensions.

Meilisearch will re-embed every existing document through your embedding API the next time it applies this - this can incur real API cost.

Save anyway?
admin.settingsSavedBody: Your settings have been saved successfully.
admin.meiliUnreachableBody: Settings were saved, but MeiliSearch is unreachable. Index settings will apply when connection is restored.
admin.indexingStartedBody: Reindexing is running in the background. Progress will appear below.
admin.semanticSearchHelp: Adds meaning-based (vector/hybrid) search on top of regular keyword search, powered by Meilisearch embedders. Requires a Meilisearch instance that supports the embedders feature (v1.13+). Read more here:
admin.semanticSearchProviderHelp: Which service generates the vector embeddings for your content. OpenAI and Ollama require the corresponding service to be reachable from Meilisearch; Hugging Face embedding happens inside Meilisearch itself.
admin.semanticSearchModelHelp: Free text - type any model name/tag your provider supports. The dropdown only offers common suggestions.
admin.semanticSearchUrlHelp: Optional for OpenAI/Ollama, required for a custom REST endpoint. Use this to point an OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, LocalAI, etc.) at its own embeddings endpoint instead of the provider's default - include the full path (e.g. .../v1/embeddings), not just the base API URL. Leave empty to use the provider's default endpoint.
admin.semanticSearchDimensionsHelp: Leave empty to let Meilisearch detect this automatically. Required for some custom REST endpoints.
admin.semanticSearchRestHelp: Use the literal tokens {{text}} and {{embedding}} where the input text and returned vector belong, matching your endpoint's request/response shape. Keep the "{{..}}" as the 2nd array item in both templates (as in the placeholders above) - it tells Meilisearch this endpoint can embed a batch of texts in one call, which it does during indexing. Removing it from only one of the two templates causes a "response has a single embedding, but request has multiple texts to embed" error.
admin.semanticSearchRatioHelp: How much weight semantic (meaning-based) matches get versus keyword matches. 0 = keyword search only, 1 = semantic search only.
admin.semanticSearchScoreThresholdHelp: Meilisearch's vector search has no built-in cutoff - by default it returns its full result limit even when nothing is a good match, ranked but not filtered. This drops hits scoring below the threshold (0 = no filtering/original behavior, 1 = only near-perfect matches). If unrelated results are showing up in the results, raise this.
admin.semanticSearchSaveNotice: Changing the provider, credentials, model, or dimensions above re-embeds every document via your embedding API the next time settings are saved. Toggling the ratio alone does not.
admin.semanticForceReindexCostNotice: Semantic search is enabled: force reindex deletes every document and re-embeds all of them from scratch via your embedding API. This can incur real API cost - a regular (non-forced) reindex does not re-embed unchanged content.
